sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 sources.bib entries tagged Ndut/Cangin (32 entries incl. Gueye 1984 'Contribution à l'étude phonétique du vocalisme du ndut', Gueye 1986 ATR correlates, Pichl 1973 'Falor et ndut', Pichl 1977 Textes/Vocabulaire Ndut, Soukka & Soukka 2011 Laalaa/Palor phonological sketches)
sources.note: Bibliographic records only; none carries a URL/DOI except Childs 2006 and Ethnologue.

sources.citation: Drolc, Ursula. 2004. A diachronic analysis of Ndut vowel harmony. Studies in African Linguistics 33(1): 35-63. doi:10.32473/sal.v33i1.107338
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: open copy online (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Nothing. Whole paper is vowel harmony (ATR/root-controlled); grep of the full text for stress/accent/prominence/tone/pitch gives zero hits (only 'syllable' as harmony domain).

sources.citation: Zuk, Fabian. 2024. Review of Merrill, John T. M., The Cangin languages. Linguistique et langues africaines 10(2). doi:10.4000/13lt8
sources.note: Review summarises the book's phonology chapter as consonant/vowel reconstruction, phonotactics and sound change; says nothing about stress, accent or prosody.

sources.citation: Mbengue, Massaer & Daniel Morgan. 2021. Manuel pour lire et écrire le ndút, 5ème édition (1ère éd. 2000 = Glottolog ref 82400). Dakar: SIL Sénégal. 99 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on word stress. Introductory notes cover dialect variants (Palu, Gíjëer), glottalised and prenasalised consonants and vowel length; 'accent' appears only as the orthographic mark on é/í/ú for vowel quality (pp. 1119, 1370, 1653 of text dump).

sources.citation: Morgan, Dan (SIL Sénégal). 2020. Alphabet ndút, 2e éd. (wall chart). Dakar: SIL.
sources.note: Letter chart with key words only; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Merrill, John T. M. 2018. The historical origin of consonant mutation in the Atlantic languages. PhD dissertation, University of California, Berkeley. 489 pp. eScholarship qt34n2t9pr
sources.note: No stress statement for Ndut or any Cangin language. The 20 'stress' hits in the full text are about Corsican/Italian lenition or the phrase 'it must be stressed'; no prosody/tone/pitch remark on Cangin.

sources.citation: Glottolog languoid page ndut1239; fr.wikipedia 'Ndut (langue)'; en.wikipedia 'Ndut language'; wone-ndut.com (Faam Ndút community site)
sources.note: No phonology/stress content; fr.wikipedia bibliography lists Morgan 1996, Gueye 1980/1984, Drolc 2004/2006, Pichl 1966, Mbengue & Morgan 2021; wone-ndut.com hosts the 2021 Manuel and alphabet chart (fetched sources).

sources.citation: Soukka, M. & H. Soukka. 2011. Esquisses phonologiques du Laalaa et Palor (langues cangin du Sénégal). SIL.

sources.note: Palor is Ndut's closest sister (Ndut-Palor subgroup); a phonological sketch with an accent section would give the subgroup pattern to check Ndut against. sil.org 403 from our machine.
